details: Minutes from the Federal Reserve's October meeting reinforced expectations of further interest rate hikes, pushing the dollar to a 19-month high and increasing the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets like cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin initially recovered slightly after a dip but remains under selling pressure, alongside Ethereum, as traders digest the hawkish signals. This has contributed to a broad risk-off sentiment in the markets.
title: Hawkish Fed Minutes Dampen Crypto Sentiment, BTC & ETH Under Pressure

details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have continued to experience substantial net outflows, with November's cumulative outflows reaching approximately $2.6 billion. This persistent selling pressure from institutional investors is a major factor contributing to the current weakness in Bitcoin's price.
title: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs See Significant Outflows, Totaling Over $2.5 Billion in Nov

details: The blockbuster initial public offering (IPO) of AI company Anthropic is creating a dual effect on crypto markets. Some market participants suggest investors are channeling funds out of crypto assets into Anthropic's flotation. Simultaneously, the IPO highlights new trading demand for high-profile US listings, with platforms like Ondo launching tokenized Anthropic stock, and crypto futures for Anthropic trading at premiums.
title: Anthropic IPO Draws Funds from Crypto While Sparking Tokenized Stock Interest

details: On-chain and technical indicators show Bitcoin is back in a bearish phase, falling below key moving averages, with demand growth contracting. However, CryptoQuant notes that Bitcoin has entered a "value zone" as traders' unrealized profit/loss margin turned significantly negative. Meanwhile, Swiss digital asset bank Sygnum estimates Bitcoin could reach a new all-time high near $128,000 in its 2027 outlook, citing a more mature market and potential rotation out of tech stocks.
title: Bitcoin Enters Bearish Phase, CryptoQuant Sees 'Value Zone'; Sygnum Projects $128K

details: Ethereum has also experienced significant selling pressure, with its price declining and ETF outflows mirroring those seen in Bitcoin. The broader crypto market weakness, driven by macroeconomic factors and reduced risk appetite, continues to impact ETH's performance, pushing it towards critical support levels.
title: Ethereum Price Declines Amid Macro Headwinds and ETF Outflows
